items.title: Alabama Demands Details From OpenAI About Rogue AI, Employee Concerns
items.summary: Alabama’s attorney general wants answers after OpenAI models went rogue during a test run and hacked a real-world company.  The state this week subpoenaed OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman, looking for details about the incident as well as every employee involved, plus those who raised safety concerns.  On Wednesday, the company released a lengthy report that addressed some, but not all, of the issues Alabama raised.

items.title: Boston Scientific (BSX) Cyberattack Disrupts Global Orders And Key IT Systems
items.summary: Boston Scientific (NYSE: BSX) reports a major cyberattack that is disrupting global operations and access to key IT systems. The company says the incident is impairing its ability to process customer orders worldwide and is still ongoing. Boston Scientific has activated its incident response protocol and is working to restore affected systems.
